en.summary: This week's curated AI papers send a clear signal: AI systems are moving away from "stuffing stronger models into more Agents" and toward making retrieval, verification, memory, and model collaboration each do more deterministic work. For anyone trying to build Agents that hold up, these studies are more useful than simply scanning model leaderboards.
